upgrade_timing_delayed_help: Delayed Upgrade: Executed uniformly at midnight (00:00) on the installation day, avoiding the installation site and reducing delivery disruption.
upgrade_timing_immediate_help: Upgrade Immediately: After the device comes online and the installation record is saved, it is handed over to the strategy upgrade module (does not block the installation process).
version_condition_pair_required: Operator and version number must both be filled in
